purpose: Exhaustive preactivation fact-slot parity corpus covering every Level 1-100 readiness edge, missing-fact lock, missing-prerequisite lock and one-time-event replay suppression.
semantic_rules: Evaluation is pure and never mutates input state.
Equivalent set semantics produce deterministic output independent of duplicate observed facts.
A one_time_event_id is proposed only when its level is eligible and the event has not already been emitted.
The oracle never grants inventory or calls upstream gameplay systems.
Levels 2-100 require the canonical matching t12.fact.slot.NNN fact and their immediate predecessor.
